meta_description:
798 likes, 54 comments - yasminkarachiwala on October 5, 2026: "Dessert that’s yummy AND gives me my protein fix? 
Now that’s a WIN WIN 🤎😋

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup almond flour
• 1/2 cup Yogabar's chocolate protein powder
• 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter
• 1/4 cup honey 
• 1 tbsp melted coconut oil
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• pinch of sea salt
• 1/4 cup chocolate chips
• flaky sea salt, for topping 

Method: 
• Mix peanut butter, honey, melted coconut oil & vanilla until smooth.

• Add almond flour, protein powder & sea salt. Mix into a soft dough.

• Fold in half the chocolate chips and press into a thin layer on parchment.

• Melt the remaining chocolate chips, spread on top & finish with flaky sea salt. 

• Freeze until firm, then break into pieces.

• Store in the fridge or freezer. If frozen, let it soften for a few minutes before eating.".
